body: Updated SceneVoxelPayload signature to (sceneID, chunkX, chunkZ int) []VoxelBlock + VoxelBlock type in system/backend.go. sendVoxelPacket now calls backend.SceneVoxelPayload() first; falls back to procedural scanChunkForVoxelBlocks() when nil returned. StaticBackend returns nil (FPS-only mode, unchanged behavior). Backend now passed as parameter to sendVoxelPacket. All tests pass.
title: S40-01: wire WorldBackend.SceneVoxelPayload() in Go server
